📖 How to use

  1. Enter purchase price, rehab budget and holding costs.
  2. Enter the expected sale price and selling-cost percentage.
  3. Read your estimated profit and ROI.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is flip profit and ROI calculated?

Profit = sale price − (purchase + rehab + holding costs) − selling costs. ROI = profit ÷ total cash in (all costs except the sale).

What are holding costs?

Mortgage payments, taxes, insurance and utilities during the project. Enter their total for the holding period.

What selling-cost percentage should I use?

A typical agent commission plus closing costs is 6–8% of the sale price; adjust the percentage to match your deal.
